page.overview:
What is RCLU?

The RCLU was an organization chaired by Dotswa Ween during the Separatist Crisis. Representing the RCLU as its chairbeing, Ween appeared on a talk show called In the Political Pit at 1935 on the date 13:4:11. The CoCo District Edition issue of HoloNet News that day advertised that Ween would be joined by actor Reridan Reksiss, Representative Jar Jar Binks, and recording artist Gaeriala Boosin as the show's panellists.

The RLCU was mentioned in "What To Scan," a website section and published in HoloNet News Vol. 531 #51 on the HoloNet News website
